svg.title: Beyond mise
svg.desc: Stacked area chart of cumulative GitHub stars since January 2025 for jdx's tools other than mise: 9.45k stars in total, about 1.86k a year earlier. jactionlint 341, mr boxington 776, aube 2074, fnox 2397, hk 1321, pitchfork 717, usage 1078, +6 more 745.

g.text: $ gh api repos/{owner}/{repo}/stargazers --paginate # every tool except mise
cumulative stars since Jan 2025, stacked by launch
